values.note: Park amenities: water, coin-operated showers and the dump station are summer only; flush toilets, showers, dump and drinking water are shut October 31 to May 15, leaving vault toilets.

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people per site; one hard-sided RV, trailer or van and one tent, or two tents. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass. Reservations are taken May 15 to September 30; in winter only Pinnacle takes them.

values.note: Electric sites $36 a night in June, a Saturday the same. Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass ($12-$17) or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

note: One of Stagecoach State Park's four campgrounds, on the southwest shore of Stagecoach Reservoir south of Steamboat Springs; the lakeside arc of the loop sits on the open reservoir shore and drawdown apron (sites near the water include ~10 and 62), other sites set back. --Claude
